Noetra 是一家由日本政府支持、专注于开发面向物理人工智能（Physical AI）和机器人基础模型的公司。

Noetra Corp., along with its core member companies and investors—Sony Group Corporation, SoftBank Corp., NEC Corporation, and Honda Motor Co., Ltd.—launched full-scale R&D for a Japan-developed multimodal foundation model that will serve as the foundation for AI-enabled robots and physical AI

Drafted, a nine-month-old startup that uses AI to turn home-design ideas into floor plans and 3D layouts.
Drafted, a San Francisco, CA-based startup that uses artificial intelligence to generate floor plans and 3D home layouts

users can enter details such as lot size, home size, and room count. Then, they can describe the type of house they want and instantly generate floor plans and 3D renderings. They can tinker with the design and get updated plans in seconds.
Generate floor plans, 3D models, renders, and professional CAD/BIM exports.
